---
description: "Use when editing SDLC documents (requirements.md, architecture.md, design-review.md, impl-plan.md). Enforces consistency and traceability."
applyTo: "*.md"
---

# Project documentation guidelines

- Maintain stable IDs (FR-*, NFR-*, AC-*) across documents.
- Use "shall" language for requirements.
- Keep documents consistent with each other.
- Prefer small, auditable diffs when updating.
- Include traceability (AC-* to FR-* mappings).
- Do not fabricate facts, file paths, or behaviors not evidenced.
